source.title: VWAP hunt 2026-10-20 (owner's brief, idea 1): The owner's VWAP pullback without the 09:45 continuation: the VWAP is the session's average traded price; in a trend the first test of it is defended by the side in profit. Who loses: the traders who fade the trend at the VWAP and are run over by the displacement.

entry.words: From 09:35 to 15:00: the bar before touched the session VWAP, then a displacement bar (body larger than the previous body, the previous bar the opposite colour) closes away from the VWAP in the direction of the VWAP's 30-minute slope -> market with it at the close. stop 25 / target 37.5 points; at most 20 a pass; flat 15:58.

taught: [owner 2026-10-20, brief prompt-vwap-5-10-a-day-3to1-blocks, idea 1] From 09:35 to 15:00: the bar before touched the session VWAP, then a displacement bar (body larger than the previous body, the previous bar the opposite colour) closes away from the VWAP in the direction of the VWAP's 30-minute slope -> market with it at the close.

[owner 2026-10-20, brief section 3] versions: bars 1 / 5 / 15, NY cash and London / overnight where the family runs, stops 25 / 30 / 40 and a structure stop, target 1.5 x the stop: this sheet is bars 1, stop 25 / target 37.5 points
not_run: PRE-REGISTERED in out/vwap_hunt_2026-10-20/PREREG.md before any run; nothing tuned on a result.
1-MINUTE SHEETS run the New York passes only (machine time); 5 / 15-minute sheets every pass the family runs except pre (08:25-09:30), which the brief does not ask for.
THE SESSION VWAP of the engine restarts at every pass start (09:30, 11:00, 13:30; 03:00 London; 00:00 Asia; 18:00 evening); 'rth' / 'us' anchors stay at 09:30 for the New York passes.
THE CAP: 20 trades per session pass (several passes: a day can hold more, and a trade of one pass may still be open when the next pass enters).
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS are read only by `bp.py taught wf` (the 3:1 block walk-forward, once), its output sent to a log unread until SELECTION.md is written.
